name: smwsprites-dragon-coin
title: Dragon Coin
description:
Sprite version of SMW's Dragon Coin object. It includes different properties, such as being able to be eaten by Yoshi, to be placed behind objects and even to spawn a sprite once the fifth+ coin is collected.

This sprite was part of Romi's Sprite Package, and was resubmitted separately after the remoderation for ease of search and to fit current standards.
